newsitem.title: GERMANY: BASF CFO sees higher share price ahead.
newsitem.headline: BASF CFO sees higher share price ahead.

text.p: The share price of German chemical giant BASF AG is likely to climb in the next few months, BASF chief financial officer Max Dietrich Kley told Reuters Financial Television on Wednesday.
"We can not be happy with our share price today. But I expect that with a better dividend the market will be better for our share price in the coming months."

BASF's share price fell earier in the day after the group reported an 8.8 percent rise in group nine-month pre-tax profits to 3.37 billion marks, but that third quarter pre-tax profits slipped 2.3 percent to 1.05 billion marks.
BASF shares in after electronic trade were down 92 pfennigs at 51.55 marks.
